missing_security_md.description: The repository is missing a SECURITY.md file detailing vulnerability reporting policies.

zero_test_coverage.description: The repository has zero or extremely low automated test coverage.

no_modular_architecture_blueprint.description: The codebase lacks a scalable, modular architecture blueprint (e.g. monolith without clear boundaries).

automated_commit_workflow_present.description: A script or GitHub Action is automatically generating empty or meaningless commits to pad the activity graph.
automated_commit_workflow_present.note: Do NOT suppress for portfolios — this is a credibility signal (fake activity padding) even when it isn't a security risk. Reframe the finding text per type; see Phase 3.

missing_ci_cd_pipeline.description: No CI/CD pipelines (e.g. GitHub Actions) exist for automated testing, linting, or deployment.

hardcoded_secrets.description: Passwords, API keys, or secrets are hardcoded in plaintext.
hardcoded_secrets.note: Always flag hardcoded secrets, but it's a critical showstopper for production/library.
